ledger.registrationStatus: Form F-3 registration became effective August 6, 2026. The prospectus covers resale by selling securityholders of up to 80,646,036 ordinary shares.
ledger.terms: The August 6 prospectus covers resale from time to time by selling securityholders of up to 80,646,036 ordinary shares, plus resale of up to 5,289,934 warrants.
ledger.holderRestrictions: Sales are by named selling securityholders or permitted transferees. The bundle does not provide current holder-by-holder lockup, ownership, or selling information.
ledger.eligibilityAssessment: The F-3 effectiveness notice and subsequent 424B3 support that the registered resale capacity may be used, but registration is not evidence that any holder has sold shares. [121921,121923]

ledger.registrationStatus: The effective F-3 prospectus registers issuance of up to 18,576,677 ordinary shares upon warrant exercise.
ledger.terms: Up to 18,576,677 ordinary shares are issuable upon exercise of warrants. The prospectus also covers resale of up to 5,289,934 warrants.
ledger.holderRestrictions: Exercise prices, exercise timing, current warrant-holder positions, and whether exercises are economically attractive are not provided in the supplied excerpts.
ledger.eligibilityAssessment: Potential supply exists if warrants are exercised, but the evidence does not establish current exercise economics or that any exercise has occurred. [121923]

ledger.registrationStatus: Included within the resale registration, subject to issuance upon operational milestones.

ledger.holderRestrictions: The precise outstanding milestone conditions and satisfaction status are not supplied in the excerpts.
